# AI Vibecoder Tools

Open-source tools by Ябука (https://jabuka.ru) and Евгений Амбросюк. MIT.

- Zoom Meeting Agent: https://github.com/jabuka777/ai-vibecoder-tools/tree/main/zoom-meeting-agent
- Separate Codex edition: https://github.com/jabuka777/ai-vibecoder-tools/tree/main/zoom-meeting-agent-codex

Zoom audio is captured and transcribed locally using Chromium and faster-whisper.
Zoom still needs a network connection. Cloud LLM processing is disabled by default;
--llm claude or --llm codex explicitly sends transcript/chat text to that provider.
Web mode listens and creates draft minutes; SDK mode can additionally answer chat.
Joining depends on meeting settings and host admission.

Draft minutes process the entire saved transcript and chat in bounded chunks,
retain quotes and source IDs, and distinguish proposals and cancellations.
They require human review and do not compute a definitive active task list.
Tests cover session isolation, HTTP authorization, capture/STT failures, full-source
coverage and CLI tool restrictions. Sixteen synthetic cases support separate live
LLM evaluation. Linux local tests do not establish live Zoom or Windows/macOS readiness.
The original twenty-minute story measures only the prototype's first join.
